newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs sees gross margins holding up.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs sees gross margins holding up.

text.p: Tellabs Inc chief executive officer Michael Birck said the company expects gross margins to hold at recent levels of 59 percent going forward.
"The indications are that our margins are likely to hold," he told Reuters after addressing an investor conference here.
Separately, Tellabs International president Peter Guglielmi said "at the moment, we believe we have the basis to grow (revenues) to at least $2 billion by the year 2000.
The revenue goal is more than double the company's 12-month trailing figure.
